user.title: Add Child
user.description: Create a new instance to manage school grades for a child.

data.child_name: Name of the child (e.g., Richard, Emma)

error.already_configured: Grade management for this child has already been set up.

abort.already_configured: Grade management for this child already exists.

add_subject.name: Add Subject
add_subject.description: Adds a new school subject to the grade overview.

remove_subject.name: Remove Subject
remove_subject.description: Deletes a school subject and all associated grades.

add_grade.name: Add Grade
add_grade.description: Records a new grade with selected weight.

remove_grade.name: Remove Grade
remove_grade.description: Deletes an existing grade by its ID.

set_calendar.name: Assign Calendar
set_calendar.description: Links a Home Assistant calendar to a child for upcoming exams.

update_timetable_cell.name: Update Timetable Cell
update_timetable_cell.description: Updates subject, room, and teacher for a specific slot and day.

import_timetable.name: Import Timetable via YAML
import_timetable.description: Imports a complete timetable as YAML text or data structure.

update_settings.name: Update General Settings
update_settings.description: Updates country grading system, section visibility, or assigned calendar for a child.

add_calendar_event.name: Create Calendar Event / Exam
add_calendar_event.description: Creates a new event or exam in the assigned calendar.

update_calendar_event.name: Update Calendar Event / Exam
update_calendar_event.description: Updates an existing event or exam in the assigned calendar.

remove_calendar_event.name: Delete Calendar Event / Exam
remove_calendar_event.description: Deletes an event or exam from the assigned calendar.
